text: 中国人民银行日前发布公告称，定于2026年10月30日发行2027版熊猫贵金属纪念币一套。这套贵金属纪念币共15枚，其中熊猫普制贵金属纪念币7枚、熊猫精制贵金属纪念币8枚，均为中华人民共和国法定货币。这套贵金属纪念币正面图案均为北京天坛祈年殿，并刊国名、年号；背面图案均为两只大熊猫相互依偎场景，并刊面额、重量及成色。（新华社）
text_en: The People's Bank of China recently announced that it will issue a set of 2027 Panda precious metal commemorative coins on October 30, 2026. The set comprises 15 precious metal commemorative coins, including 7 Panda standard precious metal commemorative coins and 8 Panda proof precious metal commemorative coins, all of which are legal tender of the People's Republic of China. The obverse of each coin features the Hall of Prayer for Good Harvests at the Temple of Heaven in Beijing, along with the country name and year; the reverse features two giant pandas nestling together, along with the face value, weight and purity. (Xinhua News Agency)
